title: Choose Three Priorities for the First Week
teaser: Too many equal priorities can make ordinary decisions harder.
message: Pick three outcomes that matter most this week and judge new requests against that order.

title: Measure the Waiting Time in One Process
teaser: Delays often collect between steps rather than inside the work itself.
message: Record the real elapsed waiting time in one process you use often from start to finish today.

title: Eliminate One Reused Password
teaser: Reusing a password can multiply the damage from a single credential leak.
message: Change one account that shares a password with another service to a unique password today.

title: Label One Expense as Need or Convenience
teaser: Convenience spending can grow quietly when it is never classified.
message: Take one purchase from today and mark whether it served a need or mainly bought convenience.

title: Lower the Friction of Starting One Task
teaser: A complicated first step can make even small work easy to postpone.
message: Prepare the files tools or materials tonight for one important task you plan to start tomorrow.

title: Store One Record With a Date or Version
teaser: Documents become confusing when updated copies cannot be distinguished.
message: Add a clear date or version marker to the current copy of one important document.

title: Identify the Most Useful Decision of the Week
teaser: Looking at outcomes helps separate effective decisions from merely busy ones.
message: Choose the decision from the last seven days that helped most and write one sentence explaining why.

title: Write the Purpose Before a Meeting Starts
teaser: Conversations drift when nobody knows what result should come out of them.
message: Before one meeting write the decision to be made or the concrete outcome that should exist afterward.

title: Run a Two Minute Device Security Check
teaser: Small security settings can remain outdated for years without being noticed.
message: Check your phone screen lock delay and automatic locking behavior and adjust them if needed.

title: Compare One Important Fact With a Second Source
teaser: A single incorrect source can distort an otherwise careful decision.
message: Take one fact that matters today and verify it against an independent second source.

title: Set a Spending Ceiling for One Day
teaser: Short limits can make casual discretionary spending easier to notice.
message: Choose a clear maximum for optional spending today and do not exceed it.

title: Clarify One Unfinished Conversation
teaser: Conversations closed by assumption can create new uncertainty later.
message: Send one short question that confirms what remains unresolved in a conversation you still think about.

title: Name the Riskiest Assumption in One Plan
teaser: Plans often fail where an unstated assumption carries too much weight.
message: For one active plan identify the single assumption that would cause the most trouble if it proved false.

title: Shrink One Promise You Made to Yourself
teaser: Personal goals that are too large can make consistency harder than necessary.
message: Turn one goal you have struggled to maintain into a smaller action you can complete today.

title: Check Cash Flow at Midmonth
teaser: Current balance alone does not show what the rest of the month will demand.
message: List expected income and payments for the remaining days and estimate the net position.

title: Prove the Cause Before Fixing the Symptom
teaser: The first explanation for a failure is often only a guess.
message: Before changing a system today gather one observation or test result that supports the suspected root cause.

title: Use Something You Recently Learned
teaser: Knowledge that never reaches practice can disappear quickly.
message: Apply one method you learned recently to a small low risk task today.

title: Verify That One Backup Can Actually Be Restored
teaser: A backup is useful only if the saved copy can still be opened and used.
message: Open one important backup file and confirm that it is readable and current enough to restore.

title: Timebox One Decision
teaser: Open ended research can delay a choice without improving it.
message: Set a stopping time for one decision today and decide with the best evidence available when that time arrives.

title: Create a Two Hour Notification Silence
teaser: Constant alerts can prevent the uninterrupted time needed for deep work.
message: Choose a two hour block today and disable every nonessential notification during it.

title: Correct One Estimate With Real Duration
teaser: Planning improves when estimated time is compared with actual time.
message: Compare the estimated and real duration of two tasks from this week and adjust next week's plan accordingly.

title: Declare One Source of Truth for a Shared File
teaser: Multiple active copies of the same document can create conflicting information.
message: For one shared project state which file is the current authoritative version.

title: Close One Small Debt or Receivable
teaser: Small open balances can create more tracking burden than their size suggests.
message: If practical settle one small debt or receivable today and update the record immediately.

title: Clean Sensitive Data From One Old File
teaser: Old documents can retain personal information long after its purpose is gone.
message: Securely delete one obsolete file or remove sensitive fields that no longer need to be stored.

title: Make Ownership Explicit for One Process
teaser: Work can stall when nobody knows who is responsible for the next decision.
message: Name one person who owns the next decision and follow through for an active process.

title: Plan to Do Less of One Thing
teaser: Improvement can come from removing load rather than adding another habit.
message: Choose one behavior you will reduce next week and write what you will do instead.

title: Review One Subscription Before Month End
teaser: Small automatic charges can continue for years without a fresh decision.
message: Choose one active subscription and decide whether you expect to use it enough next month to keep it.

title: Close February With One Transferable Lesson
teaser: A single usable lesson can matter more than a long list of observations.
message: Write the most useful lesson from this month and name where you will apply it in March.
